proposed_capability: Prevent BetterInstincts and agent-authored game adapters from changing Bluetooth service state, PnP drivers, peripheral pairing, or OS input preferences; route Windows RCA to SysAdminSuite.
player_save_control_impact: No live game, save, service, registry, driver, pairing, or mouse changes; preserves operator control.
expected_outcome: Game-side source edits introducing OS peripheral controls fail a targeted regression check; agent routing explicitly delegates legitimate Bluetooth repair to SysAdminSuite.
negative_tests: Static hostile fixture attempts Start-Service / pnputil and is rejected
Ordinary game capture and safe source remain permitted
Existing passive game capture and operator-first queue remain unchanged
Independent CI guard remains runnable when inherited Sims offline suite fails
rollback_path: Revert only this additive source boundary and its tests; no host mutation is performed.
unresolved_unknowns: Specific Windows service transition not isolated from adapter restart; user reported both mice work after service recovery.
No evidence identifies an offending Cursor agent session.
